about: P03-B2, P03-B3, P07-B1 and P04-B6 removed stray duplicate quest monsters whose Mob_IDs were in QuestMonsterIds, while the period copies they kept were not listed. Move the gamebot protection to the copies that stay.

entries.why: stray Konung Botolf Redhands (Muspelheim) removed by P03-B2; its id no longer exists
the Konung Botolf Redhands that P03-B2 keeps (blodfelag fort, West Svealand) takes over the gamebot protection of the removed copy
stray Amano (Black Mtns North) removed by P03-B3; its id no longer exists
the restored Amano outside Tepok's Mine that P03-B3 keeps takes over the gamebot protection of the removed copy
post-1.75 Lone Weeping Willow (West Svealand) removed by P07-B1; its id no longer exists
the Myrkwood Lone Weeping Willow that P07-B1 keeps takes over the gamebot protection of the removed copy
post-1.75 Ick (East Svealand) removed by P04-B6; its id no longer exists
the Gotar Ick that P04-B6 keeps takes over the gamebot protection of the removed copy
